summary: Iteration 3 — Frontend-only verification of z-index bug fix for Radix Dialogs vs Leaflet map on /mapa. Logged in as owner benjahr1993@gmail.com, opened 'Nueva NAP' dialog on /mapa, verified z-index and interactivity, submitted POST /api/nap-boxes (200 OK), and validated 8 other dialogs still render correctly on top of their pages with the same z-index. All targeted flows pass. Two non-blocking observations logged (unrelated to the fix).

issues: Stadia Maps tiles return HTTP 401 'Invalid Authentication' — tiles render as broken 401 placeholders behind the modal. Unrelated to the z-index fix, but the map background is currently unusable. Check STADIA/tile provider API key.

action_items: (Non-blocking) Fix Stadia Maps tile provider 401 auth on /mapa — tiles show '401 Error / Invalid Authentication'.
(Non-blocking a11y) Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to DialogContent to silence Radix warning 'Missing Description or aria-describedby' emitted on every dialog open.
critical_code_review_comments: Dialog z-index fix in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/dialog.jsx (z-[1100]/[1101]) plus the .leaflet-pane/.leaflet-top/.leaflet-bottom/.leaflet-control z-index:40 !important override in index.css is a targeted and correct fix. Confirmed no regressions in the other 8 dialogs tested.
seed_data_creation: Created one NAP via UI: TEST_NAP_Z (lat -34.6, lng -58.4, capacity 8, addr 'TEST addr'). POST /api/nap-boxes returned 200. Main agent may want to clean this up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: z-index fix verified. Measurements: DialogContent computed zIndex=1101, DialogOverlay=1100, .leaflet-pane=40, .leaflet-top=40. 'Nueva NAP' dialog fully visible above map, all 6 inputs typeable, Guardar submits (POST 200), dialog closes, map remains present. Regression check on 8 other 'Nuevo/Registrar' dialogs (/clientes, /planes, /pagos, /leads, /extras, /mikrotik, /tareas, /usuarios) — all opened with z=1101 and non-zero dimensions. Leftover: TEST_NAP_Z seed NAP created; Stadia tile 401 pre-existing unrelated issue.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: Radix DialogOverlay/DialogContent used Tailwind z-50 while Leaflet uses z-index up to 1000 on .leaflet-top/.leaflet-control and 400-700 on panes; because dialog was portaled to body (a sibling of the map container), the ancestor stacking contexts placed the map above the dialog for controls/tiles. Fix bumps dialog layers to 1100/1101 and forces leaflet panes/controls to z-40, guaranteeing the modal sits above the map. Verified via computed styles and by successfully interacting with inputs that previously received no clicks.
